//Cors: The two origins a storefront is served from locally: the Vite dev server (5173) while developing, and the container in the one-command stack (4173). Either way the browser treats every call as cross-origin, so both must be admitted or it blocks the request before it leaves. The stack itself runs as Production and does not read this file — it sets Cors__AllowedOrigins__0 in docker-compose.yml.
//FeatureToggles: Local/hand-testing defaults to the real identity server cut over (quickstart.md Scenarios 1-6); flip this to false — or edit it live in a running container, no restart needed, since this file reloads on change — to exercise Scenario 7's rollback path.
